verdict.language_detail: PML (Prague Markup Language) XML annotation layer — morphological annotation data for Czech PDT corpus
verdict.provenance_detail: Prague Dependency Treebank (PDT) PML m-layer morphological annotation file, manually annotated Czech text with POS tags
verdict.purpose: Morphological annotation layer of the Prague Dependency Treebank (PDT) for Czech text, storing word forms, lemmas, and morphological tags in PML/XML format. The .m extension here stands for 'm-layer' (morphological layer), not MATLAB.
